queries.item: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ?:paymos_refund_unbound ( withdrawal_id VARCHAR(128) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL, order_id INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL, payload LONGTEXT NOT NULL, result LONGTEXT NULL, review_reason VARCHAR(64) NULL, note TEXT NOT NULL, next_due BIGINT NOT NULL, created_at BIGINT NOT NULL, poll_count INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY (withdrawal_id), KEY (order_id), KEY due (next_due, withdrawal_id) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ?:paymos_refund_intent ( operation_id CHAR(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL, installation_id CHAR(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL, request_token VARCHAR(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL, payment_key VARCHAR(191) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL, external_order_id VARCHAR(200) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL, withdrawal_id VARCHAR(128) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NULL, payload LONGTEXT NOT NULL, created_at BIGINT NOT NULL, next_due BIGINT NOT NULL, poll_count INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY (operation_id), UNIQUE KEY request_token (installation_id, request_token), UNIQUE KEY (external_order_id), UNIQUE KEY (withdrawal_id), KEY (payment_key), KEY due (next_due, operation_id) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ?:paymos_refund_projection ( operation_id CHAR(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL, order_id INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL, invoice_id VARCHAR(128) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL, withdrawal_id VARCHAR(128) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL, mode VARCHAR(16) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL, note TEXT NOT NULL, result LONGTEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (operation_id), UNIQUE KEY (withdrawal_id), KEY (order_id) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `?:paymos_invoices` ( `id` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `cscart_order_id` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL, `paymos_invoice_id` varchar(128) NOT NULL, `external_order_id` varchar(128) NOT NULL, `environment` varchar(16) NOT NULL, `project_id` varchar(128) NOT NULL, `amount` varchar(64) NOT NULL, `currency` varchar(16) NOT NULL, `payment_url` text NOT NULL, `status` varchar(64) NOT NULL, `renew_count` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `created_at` datetime NOT NULL, `updated_at` datetime NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`id`), UNIQUE KEY `paymos_invoice_id` (`paymos_invoice_id`), UNIQUE KEY `external_order_id` (`external_order_id`), KEY `cscart_order_id` (`cscart_order_id`) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `?:paymos_events` ( `event_id` varchar(128) NOT NULL, `expires_at` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL, `created_at` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`event_id`), KEY `expires_at` (`expires_at`) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;
